measurement_method: CUDA allocator peak and process ru_maxrss during completed training, validation and heldout candidate inference; accelerator-synchronized per-record timings
memory_measurement_scope: peak CUDA reserved bytes; separate host RSS check against physical host RAM; CPU and GPU bytes are not pooled
latency_scope: candidate scoring, includes accelerator sync; excludes EEG loading/preprocessing and harness execution
scope: This measures feasibility on this actual Colab L4 runtime, not on M1 or SFC Mac nodes. End-to-end harness latency and autonomous capability remain unmeasured.
